description: TmGantt Blazor component in the Scheduler category.

parameters.name: ActiveBaselineId
parameters.description: Named schedule snapshots for baseline comparison.

parameters.name: ActiveTimerTaskId
parameters.description: Fires when the user creates a new virtual (placeholder) resource.

parameters.name: AllowBulkSelect
parameters.description: When true, dep-drag handles are rendered on every task bar.

parameters.name: AllowDependencyCreation
parameters.description: Fires when column visibility/order changes via the column toggle UI.

parameters.name: AllTasks
parameters.description: The task being edited.

parameters.name: AutoSchedule
parameters.description: Fires when the data order changes via cascade sort.

parameters.name: Baselines
parameters.description: When true, highlights critical-path tasks with a distinct bar color.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks "Run" on a report.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Working schedule used to shade non-working days/hours in the timeline.

parameters.name: CustomFields
parameters.description: Fires after a new baseline is saved.

parameters.name: Dependencies
parameters.description: All tasks for parent selection.

parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: Fires when a custom field value is committed for a task. Args: (taskId, fieldId, value).

parameters.name: History
parameters.description: Activity history entries to display in the history drawer.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Audit history entries to display.

parameters.name: NotificationSettings
parameters.description: Optional real-time SignalR connection for live task updates.

parameters.name: OnAttachmentRemoved
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects a file to attach.

parameters.name: OnAttachmentUpload
parameters.description: Fires when the description textarea changes (live).

parameters.name: OnAutoScheduled
parameters.description: When true, auto-schedules tasks based on dependencies when parameters are set.

parameters.name: OnBaselineSaved
parameters.description: ID of the currently active baseline to compare against.

parameters.name: OnBulkUpdate
parameters.description: Current timeline zoom preset (Weeks by default).

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the user confirms export with the chosen options.

parameters.name: OnColumnsChanged
parameters.description: Column definitions for the tree grid. Defaults to all standard columns visible.

parameters.name: OnCommentAdded
parameters.description: Fires when the user removes an attachment (by attachment Id).

parameters.name: OnCustomFieldChanged
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string TaskId, string FieldId, string? Value)>
parameters.description: User-defined custom field definitions.

parameters.name: OnDataSorted
parameters.description: Fires when the user triggers a bulk status/property update.

parameters.name: OnDependencyAdded
parameters.description: Fires when the task is saved with valid data.

parameters.name: OnDependencyRemoved
parameters.description: Fires when a new dependency is added.

parameters.name: OnDescriptionChanged
parameters.description: Fires when a dependency is removed (by its Id).

parameters.name: OnExport
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is visible.

parameters.name: OnExportRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user adds/removes filters via the filter panel.

parameters.name: OnFiltersChanged
parameters.description: Active filter set. Empty = show all tasks.

parameters.name: OnImport
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is visible.

parameters.name: OnImportCompleted
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests an export (contains selected options).

parameters.name: OnImportError
parameters.description: Fires when an import operation completes successfully.

parameters.name: OnNotificationTriggered
parameters.description: Fires when a task's status is changed from the board view.

parameters.name: OnReportRun
parameters.description: Report definitions shown in the Reports sidebar panel.

parameters.name: OnResourceCalendarChanged
parameters.description: Resource calendars for vacation/day-off overlays in People view.

parameters.name: OnRollbackRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests time-travel to the given timestamp.

parameters.name: OnStatusChanged
parameters.description: Notification preferences for the current user.

parameters.name: OnTaskUpdated
parameters.description: Existing dependencies.

parameters.name: OnTimerStarted
parameters.description: Task ID of the currently running stopwatch timer. Null = no active timer.

parameters.name: OnTimerStopped
parameters.description: Fires when the user starts the stopwatch for a task.

parameters.name: OnTimeTravelRequested
parameters.description: Audit-log entries to display in the history drawer.

parameters.name: OnViewSettingsChanged
parameters.description: View display settings (today marker, days off, density, theme…).

parameters.name: OnVirtualResourceAdded
parameters.description: Fires when a resource calendar entry changes.

parameters.name: RealtimeConnection
parameters.description: Whether workload is displayed in hours or as a percentage of capacity.

parameters.name: Reports
parameters.description: When true (default), the left sidebar navigation is visible.

parameters.name: ResourceCalendars
parameters.description: Fires when a notification condition is met (assign, mention, deadline).

parameters.name: ShowCriticalPath
parameters.description: Fires after auto-scheduling with the updated task list.

parameters.name: ShowOverdueHighlight
parameters.description: When true, each tree row shows a checkbox for bulk selection.

parameters.name: ShowSidebar
parameters.description: Fires when the user stops the stopwatch for a task, providing the completed log entry.

parameters.name: ShowWorkloadPanel
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests rollback to the state before a history entry.

parameters.name: WorkingSchedule
parameters.description: Fires when the user changes a view setting via the built-in dropdown.

parameters.name: WorkloadDisplayMode
parameters.description: When true, shows the workload panel below the Gantt timeline.

parameters.name: ZoomPreset
parameters.description: When true, overdue tasks (End in past, not done) are highlighted.
